events.terms_source: Ratio 42 HDFC Bank (FV Re 1) for 25 HDFC (FV Rs 2): https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/HDFC_04042022085440_SE_Intimation_Reg_30_040422.pdf; effective date 2023-07-01 and record date 2023-07-13: https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/HDFC_03072023123649_SE_Intimation_Effective_RecordDate_30062023.pdf; NSE corporate actions (symbol HDFC, 'Merger', record date 13-Jul-2023) and NSE notice of 04-Jul-2023 suspending HDFC equity trading w.e.f. 13-Jul-2023 (last trading day 12-Jul-2023). Cost 100% by merger rule.
events.notes: Composite scheme: HDFC Investments Ltd and HDFC Holdings Ltd (unlisted wholly owned subsidiaries) first merged into HDFC Ltd (no public-holder event), then HDFC Ltd into HDFC Bank. Effective/appointed date 2023-07-01 is not the ex-date. T+1 regime so ex-date = record date (NSE listing shows no separate ex-date). NSE corporate-action API reports stale pre-split ISINs (HDFC INE001A01028, HDFCBANK INE040A01018); current ISINs INE001A01036 / INE040A01034 used (HDFCBANK ISIN per NSE circular CML42099, 2019 sub-division). HDFC warrants (INE001A13049) also moved to HDFC Bank; not modelled as a leg. Fractional entitlements paid in cash.
